description: §4.12.2 (S445 item 5) — application-level attributes (`ratelimit=`, `headers=`) on a nested `<program>` (a worker under a `<div>` inside the application program) are E-PROGRAM-NESTED-ATTR, once per attribute. Before S445 item 5 they were read from the top-level program only and silently ignored here (MEASURED on a route file: `ratelimit="1/min"` stopped limiting, `headers="strict"` stopped sending CSP / X-Frame-Options).
rationale: §4.12.2 (S445 item 5): 'Every other `<program>` attribute is application-level and SHALL be a compile error on a nested `<program>` (`E-PROGRAM-NESTED-ATTR`), once per offending attribute.'
